text_block_list.text:
The Classic Triple Crown, the greatest 
stage for an Umamusume in her Classic 
Year. Mejiro Palmer ponders whether she 
should aim for it.

She didn't want to lose terribly and get 
laughed at. But she also admired it too 
much to simply let it pass by.

After agonizing over it at length, she 
decided to prioritize how she felt when 
the Classic Triple Crown races drew near. 
Her policy became: "Run if I want to."
